meanings.en: a good moral quality in a person
meanings.exampleEn: Patience is a virtue that few people truly possess.
meanings.exampleTr: Sabır, çok az insanın gerçekten sahip olduğu bir erdemdir.

meanings.en: in a way that can be clearly seen
meanings.exampleEn: She was visibly upset after hearing the news.
meanings.exampleTr: Haberi duyduktan sonra gözle görülür şekilde üzgündü.

meanings.en: extremely important or necessary
meanings.exampleEn: Water is vital for the survival of all living things.
meanings.exampleTr: Su, tüm canlıların hayatta kalması için hayati önem taşır.

meanings.en: a natural substance in food needed for good health
meanings.exampleEn: Oranges are an excellent source of vitamin C.
meanings.exampleTr: Portakallar mükemmel bir C vitamini kaynağıdır.

meanings.en: a singer, especially in a band
meanings.exampleEn: The band is looking for a new vocalist for their next album.
meanings.exampleTr: Grup, bir sonraki albümleri için yeni bir vokalist arıyor.

meanings.en: a person who does work without being paid
meanings.exampleEn: Many a volunteer helped clean up the beach after the storm.
meanings.exampleTr: Fırtınadan sonra birçok gönüllü plajı temizlemeye yardım etti.

meanings.en: food brought up from the stomach through the mouth
meanings.exampleEn: The smell of vomit filled the small room.
meanings.exampleTr: Küçük odayı kusmuk kokusu kapladı.

meanings.en: a person who votes in an election
meanings.exampleEn: Each voter must show identification before casting a ballot.
meanings.exampleTr: Her seçmen oy kullanmadan önce kimlik göstermek zorundadır.

meanings.en: a serious promise
meanings.exampleEn: They exchanged their wedding vows in front of family and friends.
meanings.exampleTr: Aile ve arkadaşlarının önünde evlilik yeminlerini ettiler.

meanings.en: the part of the body between the chest and hips
meanings.exampleEn: The dress fit perfectly around her waist.
meanings.exampleTr: Elbise belini mükemmel şekilde sardı.

meanings.en: a sleeveless garment worn over a shirt
meanings.exampleEn: He wore a smart waistcoat under his suit jacket.
meanings.exampleTr: Takım ceketinin altına şık bir yelek giymişti.

meanings.en: a period of time spent waiting
meanings.exampleEn: There was a long wait before the doctor could see us.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktor bizi görene kadar uzun bir bekleyiş oldu.

meanings.en: an informal walk among a crowd by a public figure
meanings.exampleEn: The queen went on a walkabout to greet the waiting crowds.
meanings.exampleTr: Kraliçe, bekleyen kalabalığı selamlamak için bir gezintiye çıktı.

meanings.en: a person who walks, especially for exercise
meanings.exampleEn: The path is popular with walkers on weekends.
meanings.exampleTr: Patika hafta sonları yürüyüşçüler arasında popülerdir.

meanings.en: a board used to cover interior walls and ceilings
meanings.exampleEn: They installed new wallboard before painting the room.
meanings.exampleTr: Odayı boyamadan önce yeni duvar levhası taktılar.

meanings.en: an edible nut with a hard, wrinkled shell
meanings.exampleEn: She sprinkled chopped walnut over the salad.
meanings.exampleTr: Salatanın üzerine doğranmış ceviz serpti.

meanings.en: a lack or absence of something
meanings.exampleEn: The plants died for want of water.
meanings.exampleTr: Bitkiler su yokluğundan öldü.

meanings.en: a ship built and armed for combat
meanings.exampleEn: The warship patrolled the coast for several weeks.
meanings.exampleTr: Savaş gemisi birkaç hafta boyunca kıyıyı devriye gezdi.

meanings.en: a period during which a war is taking place
meanings.exampleEn: Food was strictly rationed during wartime.
meanings.exampleTr: Savaş zamanında yiyecek sıkı bir şekilde karneye bağlanmıştı.

meanings.en: a flying insect with a narrow waist that can sting
meanings.exampleEn: A wasp flew into the kitchen through the open window.
meanings.exampleTr: Açık pencereden mutfağa bir eşek arısı uçtu.

meanings.en: not allowing water to pass through
meanings.exampleEn: I bought a waterproof jacket for the hiking trip.
meanings.exampleTr: Yürüyüş gezisi için su geçirmez bir ceket aldım.

meanings.en: to make or become less strong
meanings.exampleEn: The long illness began to weaken his immune system.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun süren hastalık bağışıklık sistemini zayıflatmaya başladı.

meanings.en: in a way that lacks strength or energy
meanings.exampleEn: He smiled weakly and closed his eyes.
meanings.exampleTr: Zayıfça gülümsedi ve gözlerini kapattı.

meanings.en: having a lot of money or property
meanings.exampleEn: The wealthy businessman donated millions to charity.
meanings.exampleTr: Zengin iş adamı hayır kurumlarına milyonlarca bağışladı.

meanings.en: causing tiredness or boredom
meanings.exampleEn: The long, wearisome journey left everyone exhausted.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun ve yorucu yolculuk herkesi bitkin bıraktı.

meanings.en: very tired, especially after long effort
meanings.exampleEn: The weary travelers finally reached the hotel at midnight.
meanings.exampleTr: Yorgun yolcular sonunda gece yarısı otele ulaştı.

meanings.en: the pattern or way in which cloth is woven
meanings.exampleEn: The fabric had a tight, even weave.
meanings.exampleTr: Kumaşın sıkı ve düzgün bir dokuması vardı.

meanings.en: to marry someone
meanings.exampleEn: They plan to wed next summer in a small ceremony.
meanings.exampleTr: Gelecek yaz küçük bir törenle evlenmeyi planlıyorlar.

meanings.en: a wild plant growing where it is not wanted
meanings.exampleEn: The garden was full of weeds after the rainy season.
meanings.exampleTr: Yağmurlu mevsimden sonra bahçe yabani otlarla doluydu.

meanings.en: having all parts in good proportion
meanings.exampleEn: A well-balanced diet includes fruits, vegetables, and protein.
meanings.exampleTr: Dengeli bir beslenme meyve, sebze ve protein içerir.

meanings.en: strongly made or having a strong body
meanings.exampleEn: The old house was well-built and stood firm in the storm.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski ev sağlam yapılıydı ve fırtınada dimdik durdu.

meanings.en: arranged or planned in an efficient way
meanings.exampleEn: The conference was well-organized and ran smoothly.
meanings.exampleTr: Konferans iyi düzenlenmişti ve sorunsuz ilerledi.

meanings.en: earning or providing a good amount of money
meanings.exampleEn: She left teaching for a well-paid job in finance.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmenliği bırakıp finans alanında iyi maaşlı bir işe geçti.

meanings.en: located in or coming from the west
meanings.exampleEn: The western part of the country is mostly desert.
meanings.exampleTr: Ülkenin batı kısmı çoğunlukla çöldür.

meanings.en: a grain used to make flour for bread
meanings.exampleEn: The farmers harvested the wheat in late summer.
meanings.exampleTr: Çiftçiler buğdayı yaz sonunda hasat etti.

meanings.en: to beat cream or eggs until thick, or to strike with a whip
meanings.exampleEn: Whip the cream until it forms soft peaks.
meanings.exampleTr: Kremayı yumuşak tepecikler oluşana kadar çırpın.

meanings.en: a strong alcoholic drink made from grain
meanings.exampleEn: He poured himself a glass of whiskey after dinner.
meanings.exampleTr: Akşam yemeğinden sonra kendine bir bardak viski koydu.

meanings.en: to make or become wider
meanings.exampleEn: The city plans to widen the road to reduce traffic.
meanings.exampleTr: Şehir, trafiği azaltmak için yolu genişletmeyi planlıyor.

meanings.en: a woman whose husband has died
meanings.exampleEn: The widow wore black for a year after his death.
meanings.exampleTr: Dul kadın, kocasının ölümünden sonra bir yıl boyunca siyah giydi.

meanings.en: the measurement of something from side to side
meanings.exampleEn: Please measure the width of the window before buying curtains.
meanings.exampleTr: Perde almadan önce lütfen pencerenin genişliğini ölçün.

meanings.en: a wild area of land that is not lived in or cultivated
meanings.exampleEn: They spent two weeks camping in the wilderness.
meanings.exampleTr: Vahşi doğada kamp yaparak iki hafta geçirdiler.

meanings.en: ready and happy to do something
meanings.exampleEn: She was willing to help us move the furniture.
meanings.exampleTr: Mobilyaları taşımamıza yardım etmeye istekliydi.

meanings.en: in a way that shows you are happy to do something
meanings.exampleEn: He willingly volunteered to stay late and finish the project.
meanings.exampleTr: Geç saate kadar kalıp projeyi bitirmeye isteyerek gönüllü oldu.

meanings.en: a victory in a game or contest
meanings.exampleEn: The team celebrated their first win of the season.
meanings.exampleTr: Takım, sezonun ilk galibiyetini kutladı.

meanings.en: having many bends and turns
meanings.exampleEn: We drove slowly along the narrow, winding mountain road.
meanings.exampleTr: Dar ve dolambaçlı dağ yolunda yavaşça ilerledik.

meanings.en: the front window of a car or other vehicle
meanings.exampleEn: The rain made it hard to see through the windshield.
meanings.exampleTr: Yağmur ön camdan görmeyi zorlaştırdı.

meanings.en: a quick closing and opening of one eye as a signal
meanings.exampleEn: He gave her a friendly wink across the room.
meanings.exampleTr: Odanın öbür ucundan ona dostça bir göz kırptı.

meanings.en: to clean or dry something by rubbing it
meanings.exampleEn: Please wipe the table after you finish eating.
meanings.exampleTr: Yemeğini bitirdikten sonra lütfen masayı sil.

meanings.en: the ability to say clever and amusing things
meanings.exampleEn: Her sharp wit made everyone at the table laugh.
meanings.exampleTr: Keskin nüktesi masadaki herkesi güldürdü.

meanings.en: to take back or remove something
meanings.exampleEn: I need to withdraw some cash from the bank.
meanings.exampleTr: Bankadan biraz nakit para çekmem gerekiyor.

meanings.en: the act of taking something back or out
meanings.exampleEn: She made a large withdrawal from her savings account.
meanings.exampleTr: Tasarruf hesabından büyük bir para çekme işlemi yaptı.

meanings.en: a person who sees an event and can describe it
meanings.exampleEn: The witness described exactly what she had seen.
meanings.exampleTr: Tanık, tam olarak ne gördüğünü anlattı.

meanings.en: clever and amusing in speech
meanings.exampleEn: His witty remarks kept the audience entertained.
meanings.exampleTr: Esprili sözleri izleyiciyi eğlendirdi.

meanings.en: a wild animal that looks like a large dog
meanings.exampleEn: A lone wolf howled in the distance that night.
meanings.exampleTr: O gece uzakta yalnız bir kurt uludu.

meanings.en: causing wonder; remarkable and beautiful
meanings.exampleEn: The travelers saw the wondrous beauty of the northern lights.
meanings.exampleTr: Yolcular kuzey ışıklarının hayranlık uyandıran güzelliğini gördü.

meanings.en: the art of cutting shapes and figures into wood
meanings.exampleEn: He learned woodcarving from his grandfather.
meanings.exampleTr: Ahşap oymacılığını büyükbabasından öğrendi.

meanings.en: without speaking any words
meanings.exampleEn: She wordlessly handed him the letter and walked away.
meanings.exampleTr: Tek kelime etmeden mektubu ona uzattı ve uzaklaştı.

meanings.en: unable to stop working and feeling a strong need to work
meanings.exampleEn: My workaholic boss answers emails even on holidays.
meanings.exampleTr: İşkolik patronum tatillerde bile e-postalara cevap veriyor.

meanings.en: a heavy table for working on with tools
meanings.exampleEn: He laid the tools out neatly on his workbench.
meanings.exampleTr: Aletleri çalışma tezgâhının üzerine düzgünce dizdi.

meanings.en: a man who does physical or skilled labor
meanings.exampleEn: A workman came to repair the broken fence.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir işçi, kırık çiti onarmaya geldi.

meanings.en: a table used for doing work or a craft
meanings.exampleEn: The tailor spread the fabric across the worktable.
meanings.exampleTr: Terzi kumaşı çalışma masasının üzerine serdi.

meanings.en: experienced in life and the ways of the world
meanings.exampleEn: Her worldly knowledge came from years of traveling.
meanings.exampleTr: Görmüş geçirmiş bilgisi, yıllarca süren seyahatlerinden geliyordu.

meanings.en: a person's way of understanding the world
meanings.exampleEn: Traveling abroad completely changed his worldview.
meanings.exampleTr: Yurt dışına seyahat etmek dünya görüşünü tamamen değiştirdi.

meanings.en: existing or happening throughout the world
meanings.exampleEn: The company has a worldwide network of offices.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirketin dünya çapında bir ofis ağı var.

meanings.en: a long, thin creature with no legs that lives in soil
meanings.exampleEn: The bird pulled a worm out of the wet ground.
meanings.exampleTr: Kuş, ıslak topraktan bir solucan çıkardı.

meanings.en: too old or damaged to use, or extremely tired
meanings.exampleEn: He finally threw away his wornout shoes.
meanings.exampleTr: Sonunda yıpranmış ayakkabılarını attı.

meanings.en: causing anxiety or concern
meanings.exampleEn: The test results showed a worrying increase in pollution.
meanings.exampleTr: Test sonuçları kirlilikte endişe verici bir artış gösterdi.

meanings.en: to become or make worse
meanings.exampleEn: The patient's condition began to worsen overnight.
meanings.exampleTr: Hastanın durumu gece boyunca kötüleşmeye başladı.

meanings.en: the practice of showing respect and love for a god
meanings.exampleEn: People gathered at the temple for morning worship.
meanings.exampleTr: İnsanlar sabah ibadeti için tapınakta toplandı.

meanings.en: having no value or use
meanings.exampleEn: The old coins turned out to be completely worthless.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski paralar tamamen değersiz çıktı.
